decisions.reason: The software platform builds directly on the firm's existing GIS and software engineering knowledge, so its absorptive capacity enables interpreting early results and improving the product rather than dropping it.
Mobile field data capture is close to the firm's established mobile and geospatial applications, allowing the firm to assimilate feedback and refine the offer using its in-house R&D.
The search extension leverages the firm's web map app expertise and has shown ongoing version development, indicating strong absorptive capacity and low likelihood of discontinuation.
